title: design-qa state matrix
description: Array of state-matrix rows (the same shape as report.stateMatrix[]), as written by scripts/lib/state-discovery.mjs. Rows are only the states the design (Figma or prototype) defines. Results produced before capture are provisional: CANNOT_VERIFY rows noted "pending capture" are replaced by PASS/FAIL once the state has been captured and compared.

state.description: Normalised state id: with-data, empty, loading, error, hover, focus, active, selected, disabled, … Multi-screen passes write "<screen>/<state>" (e.g. "cart/empty").

screen.description: Multi-screen passes: the meta.screens id this state belongs to (the prefix of state).

captured.description: Images of this state: design (exported from Figma or captured from the prototype), app and diff.

figma.errorMessage: captured.figma was renamed to captured.design in 2.0

x-removed.MISSING_IN_DESIGN: MISSING_IN_DESIGN was removed in 2.0: the state matrix lists only states the design defines; drop this row
